}}'''Nesair''' is a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nesair}}

==Appearance==
She is fiery-haired and beautiful, with white scars on both sides of her sun-dark cheeks.

==Activities==
She left the [[Shaido]] to be with [[Rand al'Thor]]. She along with the rest of the [[Maidens of the Spear]], were furious at being left behind during Rand al'Thor's campaign's against [[Illian]] and the [[Seanchan]]. Because the Maidens think of Rand as a first-brother, she is one of three who beat him up him as punishment when he returns to [[Cairhien]]. She tells him that she left her clain for him, and that he should not repay that by spitting on her.
